name: create_task
description: Creates a new task. Tasks are used to track the activities done to achieve a project.

description.description: precise description of the task, should include relevant details of what needs to be done and how

createdBy.description: the id of the agent that creates the task

assignee.description: the id of the agent assigned to the task, can be identical to 'createdBy' field if the task is auto-assigned

projectId.description: the id of the project if available, if not the tool will try to infer the project from the environment

name: update_task
description: Updates a task. Task updates are used to track activity relative to task achievement

newStatus.description: the new status of the task, can only take the values : 'CREATED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED','ABORTED','ON_ERROR'

newComment.description: precise description of the task update, should include relevant details of what was done and how

updatedBy.description: the id of the agent that updates the task

name: read_task
description: Reads a task. Helpful to find all needed information to accomplish the task.
